cancelled.error: AbortError: signal is aborted without reason

browserLimitations: Chrome 152 rejects the executeTool caller when its signal aborts, but passes only one callback argument. It does not provide the execution signal documented for newer implementations, so the read-only corpus fetch completes. The site handles execution signals when supplied and its own registration cleanup signal independently.
